card.name: Words just before 'nobody' or 'unoccupied'
card.fires_on: Short words or word starts right before a likely 'nobody', 'unoccupied', 'unattended' or 'inhabited', in sentences about places or things with no people present or in use.

modes.label: Before 'nobody'
modes.description: Linking words in the tree-falls-in-the-forest phrase, just ahead of 'nobody around'.
modes.example: (If a tree falls in the forest and<< there>> is nobody around does it make a sound

modes.label: Before un- words
modes.description: The un- start of words meaning no one is present, such as unoccupied or unattended.
modes.example: dim to low light levels during<< un>>occupied periods were also installed at UC Davis

modes.label: Not in use / inhabited
modes.description: Words like 'when' or 'be' before a phrase about being empty, not in use, or lived in.
modes.example: make sure it is covered<< when>> not in use to prevent evaporation.

card.writes: It pushes the output toward words meaning nobody, unoccupied or inhabited, mostly in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that no one is there or that a place is empty or lived in.
